items.title: Norse Atlantic Collapses: Airline Cancels Flights, Strands Passengers
items.why: Audit trip cancellation and delay coverage for airline-failure scenarios, since stranded cardholders will test those benefits.
items.summary_ai: Norse Atlantic cancelled its flights with little notice after warning its finances were critical, stranding passengers.
items.take: Audit trip cancellation and delay coverage for airline-failure scenarios, since stranded cardholders will test those benefits.
